items.title: Your serverless attendee’s guide to AWS re:Invent 2026
items.summary: AWS re:Invent 2026 offers an extensive selection of serverless and application integration content, including new AWS Lambda execution models, AI agents as a new kind of serverless consumer, and maturing event-driven patterns. This guide helps you navigate the serverless sessions and find the content most relevant to you.
items.creator: Nicolas Tarzia
